title: Invasion Of Muhammad Ghuri
definition: The military campaigns of Mu'izz ad-Din Muhammad Ghori (1175–1206 CE) that transitioned Islamic rule from transient raids to the establishment of a permanent Sultanate in Northern India.
importanceInUpsc: Fundamental to understanding the transition from the Rajput period to the Delhi Sultanate; frequently tested for chronological accuracy, military tactics, and socio-political impact.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Invasion Of Muhammad Ghuri.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
